thread:
Marissa Cole: Heads up: seeing a weird edge case w/ the new onboarding nudge/checklist. A user dismissed the “Create an API key” nudge, then it re-appeared on the next page load. Also shows up on the wrong page (I saw it on /settings/billing) :grimacing:

Kenji Nakamura: yep, same here while dogfooding. Screenshot: it’s rendering in the right rail on billing settings (not supposed to). Dismissed, refreshed, it came back.

Paula Mendes: do we know if this is specific to a cohort/flag? Or everyone? Also if dismissal is reappearing, our CTR/completion will be noisy.

Marissa Cole: I’m in the lifecycle_growth_nudges flag (treatment). Not sure about holdout.

Dylan Brooks: thanks. Can someone drop exact repro steps + env? Also which nudge ID (api_key / first_request / streaming / usage_dashboard)?

Kenji Nakamura: Repro (Chrome, prod):
1) Login -> land on console home
2) Nudge shows “Create an API key”
3) Click “Not now” (dismiss)
4) Navigate to Settings > Billing (URL: /settings/billing)
5) Nudge shows again (same copy/CTA)
6) Refresh on /settings/billing -> still shows

Marissa Cole: It’s definitely the api_key nudge. Also noticed it sometimes shows even after you already have a key (I have one in my personal org).

Chloe Martin: showing on /settings/billing sounds like route allowlist check is too broad. If we’re doing `pathname.includes('/settings')` instead of exact match, it’ll render anywhere under settings.

Ethan Park: +1. On dismissal persistence: I remember we’re using localStorage for v1. If the storage key is only `nudge_id`, it may get reset if the user switches orgs or if we’re rendering under a different app shell.

Dylan Brooks: @Ethan Park can you confirm keying + TTL? If it’s no TTL + still reappearing, that suggests key mismatch rather than expiry.

Ethan Park: quick look from memory (need to verify in PR-28458): dismissal key is `rdw:nudges:dismissed:${nudgeId}`. No org/user scoping. No TTL. If you switch orgs we don’t clear localStorage, so it *should* still be dismissed. But if nudgeId differs between contexts (e.g., `api_key` vs `api_key_v2`), you’d see it again.

Benji Okafor: also possible the component is mounted twice w/ two different IDs depending on page (home uses “api_key”, settings uses “onboarding_api_key”). I saw that pattern elsewhere.

Paula Mendes: if it’s showing after API key exists, eligibility check might be using a cached user profile and not re-fetching. Or the “has_api_key” boolean is scoped to org but we’re reading from the wrong org.

Chloe Martin: we do have org-scoped API keys. If user has a key in org A but is currently in org B, nudge might be correct. But Kenji said personal org and still saw it after key creation in same org?

Kenji Nakamura: yeah same org. I created a new key, went back to home, still showed “Create an API key” until I hard refreshed.

Dylan Brooks: ok sounds like 2 issues:
(1) placement bug: nudge rendering on pages it shouldn’t (/settings/billing)
(2) state bug: dismissal + eligibility not sticking / updating

Marissa Cole: yes. Can we hotfix (1) today? It’s pretty jarring to have onboarding CTAs on billing.

Leila Farouk: for QA: do we have expected placement list somewhere? I can validate against a URL matrix if we confirm.

Marissa Cole: expected: only on Console Home + the API Keys page + maybe the Quickstart page. Not in settings/billing/security.

Benji Okafor: I can take (1). I’ll change route matching to explicit allowlist (exact pathnames) in the nudge component. Will add a quick unit test so we don’t regress.

Dylan Brooks: great. @Benji Okafor please open a patch PR + tag me + @Kenji Nakamura for UI review.

Ethan Park: I’ll debug (2). Next steps:
- confirm if there are multiple nudge IDs for API key step
- check if dismissal event sets local state but gets overwritten on rerender (e.g., server-provided “eligible” wins)
- check if eligibility data is cached and not invalidated after API key creation

Paula Mendes: please also ensure we’re emitting `onboarding_nudge_dismissed` once (no duplicates). We already had duplicate signup events earlier and don’t want more measurement weirdness.

Dylan Brooks: +1. If dismissal doesn’t persist, we risk inflating impressions and annoying users.

Chloe Martin: on eligibility after key creation: if the API keys list is fetched client-side but the nudge eligibility comes from `/me` which is cached for 5 min, it would explain “still shows until hard refresh”. Fix could be invalidating `/me` cache on key creation or just refetching eligibility.

Ethan Park: that’s likely it. I’ll confirm. If so, we can invalidate the user/org profile query when `api_key_created` succeeds.

Marissa Cole: what’s the owner for that invalidate? Console frontend?

Dylan Brooks: yep Console & tooling. @Ethan Park can you open an ENG ticket + link in here once created.

Ethan Park: will do.

Leila Farouk: once the PRs are up, I can run a quick regression:
- dismiss nudge on home -> navigate across pages -> confirm stays dismissed
- create API key -> confirm nudge transitions to next step without hard refresh
- confirm it never shows on settings routes

Benji Okafor: patch plan for (1):
- allowlist paths: `/console`, `/console/quickstart`, `/console/api-keys` (confirm exact)
- for any other path, component returns null
- behind existing feature flag so it only affects the experiment cohort

Marissa Cole: works for me. `/console` is our “home”. Quickstart is `/console/quickstart`. API keys is `/console/api-keys`.

Dylan Brooks: cool. Let’s do this:
- (1) hotfix PR today, ship asap
- (2) eligibility + dismissal persistence: fix by end of week if possible; if cache invalidation is small, also hotfix

Paula Mendes: and please drop a note in #marketing once we ship so Growth knows why CTR might dip (less accidental impressions on billing pages).

Ethan Park: ack. I’ll post once merged.

Marissa Cole: thank you. This is exactly the kind of papercut that’ll tank sentiment if we don’t fix quickly.

Benji Okafor: PR coming shortly.

Dylan Brooks: thanks all. Tagging for tracking: @Benji Okafor owns placement fix. @Ethan Park owns dismissal/eligibility persistence. @Leila Farouk QA once in staging.

Kenji Nakamura: :thumbsup: I’ll re-dogfood after patch lands.
